Replaces sso-integration: Google/desktop SSO were deleted by user decision (AGENTS.md, Revisions 19 November 2026). Sign-in is legacy password (Django-compatible PBKDF2) plus OTP/TOTP with Redis sessions (backend/parity/w3-report.md, security decisions S1-S16). Pending until verified against a staging deployment with real OTP delivery.

User-supplied tssgcp2025/tss_mysql_raw_layer read-only access and asia-south1 location are verified. Historical source coverage, published projections/manifests and complete CDC/source freshness contracts remain unresolved; historical MySQL fallback is forbidden.

No sandbox or live provider evidence (API-v2 pos/order, payment microservice, Paytm/Pine terminals, Gupshup, Netcore, mailr, Borzo). Request shapes and goldens only; e2e uses loopback stand-ins (backend/tools/e2e/order-api.ts). Needs provider sandbox credentials.

Source-pinned transaction-scoped ORM candidate implemented and locally tested under an explicit opt-in contract. The old backup is incompatible with inspected physical schema; complete deployed-writer/stock-writer parity remains uncertified.

W16 query plans pass the production live read-only plan gate (backend/evidence/live-readonly-2026-11-19-r4.json: 16/16 paths, 0 plan rejections, 3 LIMIT-bounded plans). No load or latency benchmark exists.
S1-S57 recorded in backend/parity/security-decisions.md, pending user review. Route validation 335/335 and log redaction tests pass (W18). No independent security review or penetration test.

Desktop offline billing (encrypted SQLite, cash + manual card/UPI reference, provisional reference as a comments row, env limits) passes 12/12 Electron e2e scenarios on loopback (W17; W18 rerun 12/12 after one flaky run). Web clients need internet (AGENTS.md). Real keychain/DPAPI, physical printers and devices on both operating systems remain uncertified.
Unsigned macOS arm64 package builds (W18). Needs an Apple Developer ID certificate, notarisation credentials and a Windows Authenticode certificate (backend/parity/w17-report.md section 4).

Backend and frontend images build and the container smoke passes 10/10 (backend/evidence/container-smoke-f600dd54-single-stack.json). Staff must sign in again at cut-over; Redis must run with maxmemory-policy noeviction. No staged deployment or rollback rehearsal.
Redis job queue and worker (backend/src/jobs, npm run worker:jobs) are implemented with loopback MySQL/Redis tests (W8). No live run of worker:jobs, S3, Netcore or Slack.

Complete unsigned Windows/macOS native jobs pass on851f620 (run44268539314), including native restart/offline, browser recovery, packaging, integrity and sandbox. Earlier6c Windows OTP failure remains archived with its cause unresolved; unchanged assertions pass on851. Signing, installation/upgrade distribution, physical printers/devices and production acceptance remain required; this requirement is not promoted by CI alone.
